title: Join an Ongoing Meeting
description: Takvimdeki veya bildirimdeki aktif/yaklaşan bir toplantıya katılma akışı

steps.action: Click the Calendar icon on the left sidebar
Find the meeting that is currently active or upcoming in the calendar view
Click the 'Join' button on the meeting details panel
In the pre-join screen, configure camera and microphone settings
Click the 'Join now' button to enter the meeting

expectedResult: User successfully joins the meeting and can see other participants
